title.full: Cannot log in to CPF Mobile with the Singpass QR code

summary.text: You need the Singpass app. Set Safari or Chrome as your default browser, or choose Password login instead.

details.heading: Browsers that work
details.body: Safari 12.1 and above, or Chrome 78 and above, set as your phone's default browser.

details.heading: No Singpass app?
details.body: Choose ‘Password login’ on the Singpass login page, and log in with your Singpass ID and password.

details.heading: Still cannot log in
details.body: Contact the Singpass Helpdesk for help with Singpass login.

example_phrasings: CPF app scan QR code cannot log in
cannot log in to CPF mobile
singpass QR code not working for CPF

sources.page_title: Why am I unable to log in to CPF Mobile through the Singpass QR code?

quotes.text: The Singpass app is required in order to log in to CPF Mobile using the Singpass QR code.
To ensure a seamless login experience, please set one of the browsers above as your mobile device’s default browser.
Alternatively, you may log in without the Singpass app by selecting ‘Password login’ on the Singpass login page and logging in using your Singpass ID and password.
If you continue to face issues pertaining to Singpass login, please contact the Singpass Helpdesk directly for further assistance.
